questions.questionText: What key limitation of RNNs/LSTMs does attention solve?
options: Attention lets every position directly relate to every other position regardless of distance, instead of relying on information passed step by step through a chain
Attention removes the need for any training data
Attention only works on images, not text
There is no real difference from LSTMs
questions.correctAnswer: Attention lets every position directly relate to every other position regardless of distance, instead of relying on information passed step by step through a chain
questions.explanation: Self-attention computes direct relevance between any two positions in a single step, avoiding the need for information to survive being passed through many intermediate hidden states.

questions.questionText: What do the query, key, and value projections represent in self-attention?
options: Three unrelated random transformations with no specific purpose
Query = what this position is looking for; key = what a position offers to be matched against; value = what's actually returned if selected
They are three different loss functions
They only apply to the first token in a sequence
questions.correctAnswer: Query = what this position is looking for; key = what a position offers to be matched against; value = what's actually returned if selected
questions.explanation: Query-key dot products determine relevance (attention weights), and those weights are used to blend the value vectors into the output for each position.

questions.questionText: Why do transformers need positional encoding at all?
options: They don't — transformers inherently understand word order
Without recurrence, attention alone treats a sequence like an unordered set, so positional information must be added explicitly
Positional encoding is only needed for images, not text
It replaces the need for the attention mechanism entirely
questions.correctAnswer: Without recurrence, attention alone treats a sequence like an unordered set, so positional information must be added explicitly
questions.explanation: Removing recurrence (what enables full parallelization) also removes any inherent sense of order, so transformers add a positional signal to each token's embedding to compensate.
